docker-compose.yml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  mongodb:
    image: mongo:latest
    ports:
      - "27017:27017"
  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
apps/api/.env.example:
PORT=8000
MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/niveshiq
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
JWT_SECRET=supersecret
JWT_EXPIRES_IN=7d
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
AWS_S3_BUCKET=
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000
